name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.62 / build 63 adds encrypted per-patient Help Bot history saved on this Android device, a reference-style Prepare a Support Message form with explicit copy, and appointment-update comment popups in Notifications instead of Appointment Schedule. No automatic transcript sharing or cloud chat synchronization; live-agent conversations remain separate. Existing home-service booking behavior is unchanged. Phone push delivery needs separate Expo/FCM configuration and is not verified. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
